title: The River Takes Another Valley

plate.narration: Two valleys run between the glacier ridges. An old path follows one; fresh water fills the other. High on the slope, a chipped stone marker still points along the ridge.

goal.text: Follow the changed river and find a safe way across.

steps.label: Get across to the far path

arrival.narration: Pip Thistledown, a young manticore scout, stops so suddenly that his notebook bumps his nose. A river roars through a valley his sketch shows dry. A yeti worker waves a staff from the high bank. "Stay up there! Help me warn the next traveler, then get us and our tools across," the worker calls. Your job is to find a safe way across. Pip sighs. "The road changed without telling the map."

variants.text: Pip keeps your road plan open beside his sketch.
Pip keeps the stone count on his page, just in case.

look_again.narration: An old route marker has a fork-shaped chip. That has not changed. Below it, the old stream bed lies dry. The water pours between two ridges farther west instead. Pip turns his sketch the right way up. "What should we compare to see what moved?"

look_again_1.narration: You stay on the upper path. Pip holds his drawing up against the sky. You find the chipped marker, then the two ridges.

look_again_2.narration: You follow the dry bed along its firm top edge. Nobody steps into the new stream. Dry stones might not stay dry.

look_again_1_check.prompt: Compare the marker with both ridges. Pip holds the sketch steady.

look_again_2_check.prompt: Trace the dry bed from firm ground. Pip calls out each bend.

look_again_1_done.narration: The marker and ridges match the drawing. Only the water has moved. Pip taps the blank valley. "The map is right. The river is the one being wrong."

look_again_1_changed.narration: Blowing snow hides one ridge, and your first look points the wrong way. You wait and look again. The landmarks match. Only the water has moved.

look_again_2_done.narration: The marker and ridges match the drawing. Only the water has moved. Pip taps the blank valley. "The map is right. The river is the one being wrong."

look_again_2_changed.narration: Blowing snow hides one ridge, and your first look points the wrong way. You wait and look again. The landmarks match. Only the water has moved.

road_plan.narration: Pip opens the road plan from the stone keepers. You hold its landmarks up beside the changed valley.

road_plan_check.prompt: Use the road plan's landmarks to check the new route.

worksite.narration: A yeti route worker meets you on the near bank. Across the stream, a second worker waits on a low shelf with a tool bundle and an unlit lantern. A high path climbs from her shelf to the yetis' reading rooms. "One job before you cross: lift the tools high, or rig her upper handline," says the route worker. "We will need the other if the water changes."

test_flow.narration: The worker drops a twig into the stream. Where does it pass the big middle rock? A calm pocket there could carry a rope.

interaction.cue: Mark where the twig passes the calm pocket.

onSuccess.narration: You spot a calm pocket behind the rock.

onFailure.narration: Spray hides the twig. The worker pokes a pole in and finds the calm pocket.

onAssisted.narration: You spot a calm pocket behind the rock.

flow_result.narration: The calm pocket leads to a low shelf crossing. A longer high rock reach goes around it. "Neither one promises the water will stay here," says the route worker. The workers stretch a guide rope across. The far worker lifts her lantern: she can see you.

bundle_plan.narration: There is time for one preparation before your party crosses. Lift the tools to a high rack and they stay dry, but the far worker may need help later. Or rig her handline, so she can climb out herself, and leave her tools low. Which comes first?

tools_hoist.narration: The far worker straps the tools onto a carrying board. Guide her hauling line up to the rack.

interaction.cue: Guide the board toward the high rack.

onSuccess.narration: The board lands on the rack. The tools are safe up high.

onFailure.narration: A strap snags. The far worker holds the board while you try a slower lift.

onAssisted.narration: The board lands on the rack. The tools are safe up high.

tools_hoist_assisted.narration: The far worker straps the tools onto a carrying board. Guide her hauling line up to the rack. Your duskrunner keeps the straps clear.

interaction.cue: Guide the board toward the high rack.

onSuccess.narration: The board lands on the rack. The tools are safe up high.

onFailure.narration: A strap snags. The far worker holds the board while you try a slower lift.

onAssisted.narration: The board lands on the rack. The tools are safe up high.

tools_steps.narration: The far worker carries the board up the stone steps. Keep it level while she lifts it onto the rack.

interaction.cue: Level the tool board before the worker lifts it.

onSuccess.narration: Slowly, the tools reach the rack.

onFailure.narration: Slowly, the tools reach the rack.

onAssisted.narration: Slowly, the tools reach the rack.

tools_tie.narration: Pass the rack line along the bank so the far worker can tie it tight.

interaction.cue: Pass the retaining line along the bank.

onSuccess.narration: The tools are tied up high. The far worker stays on her shelf.

onFailure.narration: The tools are tied up high. The far worker stays on her shelf.

onAssisted.narration: The tools are tied up high. The far worker stays on her shelf.

people_line.narration: Hold the guide board steady from your bank. The far worker fixes a handline from her shelf up to the high path.

interaction.cue: Steady the board while the worker fixes the upper handline.

onSuccess.narration: The handline is fixed. The tools stay on the low shelf.

onFailure.narration: The handline is fixed. The tools stay on the low shelf.

onAssisted.narration: The handline is fixed. The tools stay on the low shelf.

people_braced.narration: Your thornguard uses a skill called Brace and holds the guide board still as a rock. The far worker fixes her handline in no time. Her tools stay on the low shelf.

people_signal.narration: The far worker climbs her new handline to the top. Wave the near worker's lantern when she gets there.

interaction.cue: Confirm when the worker reaches the high-path interval.

onSuccess.narration: She reaches the top and climbs back to her watch.

onFailure.narration: The lantern goes up too early. She waves, finishes the climb and goes back to watch.

onAssisted.narration: She reaches the top and climbs back to her watch.

signals.narration: The workers demonstrate lantern up for wait, staff sideways for stop and a hand toward the path for clear. Everyone practices. Pip tucks his notebook under one arm. It is having a very quiet adventure.

camp.narration: The near worker shares warm tea from a flask. Pip draws two river lines and puts his eraser away. Everything is ready. Now everyone has to get across.

crossing_choice.narration: The low shelf has a guide rope and a calm pocket. The high rock reach is slower, but it stays above the ice. "If your route shifts, we will help you use the other one," says the route worker. Which way will you cross?

crossing_choice_1_check.narration: Wait for the worker's clear signal, then step along the low shelf.

interaction.cue: Step onto the low shelf when it is clear.

onSuccess.narration: Your party reaches the far path along the low shelf.

onFailure.narration: The shelf wobbles! You hurry back and head for the high rocks instead.

onAssisted.narration: Your party reaches the far path along the low shelf.

crossing_choice_2_check.narration: The worker points to the next foothold on the high rocks. Wait for her clear signal.

interaction.cue: Cross the high rocks when the worker signals clear.

onSuccess.narration: Your party reaches the far path by the high rocks.

onFailure.narration: A foothold wobbles! The worker waves you down to the low shelf.

onAssisted.narration: Your party reaches the far path by the high rocks.

high_recovery.narration: Hold the high guide line steady while everyone climbs the rocks.

interaction.cue: Steady the guide line for the high rock reach.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone gets across by the high rocks.

onFailure.narration: Everyone gets across by the high rocks.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone gets across by the high rocks.

low_recovery.narration: The workers hold the guide rope steady while everyone follows the low shelf.

interaction.cue: Keep the guide board level for the low-shelf crossing.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone gets across along the low shelf.

onFailure.narration: Everyone gets across along the low shelf.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone gets across along the low shelf.

crossing_choice_1_done.narration: The last hero steps onto firm ground. Pip checks every face and gives a thumbs-up with his tail. Nobody was left behind. You came along the supported low shelf.

crossing_choice_2_done.narration: The last hero steps onto firm ground. Pip checks every face and gives a thumbs-up with his tail. Nobody was left behind. You came by the high rock reach.

river_turn.narration: From the far path, you can see both valleys. Water noses into the old bed while the western stream grows quieter. Pip drops his eraser. "It is changing back!"

return_observation.narration: Three things are changing: the western stream, the old bed and the quiet western channel. Which changes first?

onSuccess.narration: You remember the whole change, in order.

onFailure.narration: Spray hides the middle part. You leave that part blank.

return_observation.prompt: Watch the river through the spray. Pip whispers, "Keep your eyes open."

return_water.narration: The old bed is filling. You are safe up high, but one job is still waiting below. You can do it, or let the workers finish while you carry their gear.

worker_beacon.narration: The tools are dry, but the far worker needs a clear way up. Pass the lantern directions down the high path.

interaction.cue: Pass the directions down to the worker.

onSuccess.narration: She follows the lights up to you. The tools stay dry on their rack.

onFailure.narration: She follows the lights up to you. The tools stay dry on their rack.

onAssisted.narration: She follows the lights up to you. The tools stay dry on their rack.

tool_recover.narration: The far worker climbs your handline to you. Now swing a hook down to the tool bundle's loop.

interaction.cue: Catch the bundle loop from the high path.

onSuccess.narration: The bundle swings up out of the water. The tools are dry.

onFailure.narration: The water reaches the bundle first. The worker pulls it up, dripping.

onAssisted.narration: The bundle swings up out of the water. The tools are dry.

tool_recover_assisted.narration: The far worker climbs your handline to you. Now swing a hook down to the tool bundle's loop. Your duskrunner keeps the straps clear.

interaction.cue: Catch the bundle loop from the high path.

onSuccess.narration: The bundle swings up out of the water. The tools are dry.

onFailure.narration: The water reaches the bundle first. The worker pulls it up, dripping.

onAssisted.narration: The bundle swings up out of the water. The tools are dry.

wet_tools.narration: Hold the board level while the workers lay the wet tools out. A hammer drips on Pip's foot.

interaction.cue: Level the board for the wet tools.

onSuccess.narration: Cleaning them will take all afternoon.

onFailure.narration: Cleaning them will take all afternoon.

onAssisted.narration: Cleaning them will take all afternoon.

workers_takeover.narration: You stay up high while the workers finish below with their spare line. Then they ask you to carry their repair gear to the reading-room path.

variants.text: Their tools are still dry on the rack.
The low bundle gets soaked first.

repair_gear.narration: You wind a new cord for their spare line and spread out drying cloths. Wet tools still cost the workers an afternoon, but your help makes it faster.

tell_together.narration: The river runs in its older bed again. Pip opens his page. "Time to write down the crossing and how the river came back." You can tell it by the landmarks. If you watched the whole change, you can tell that.

record_landmarks.narration: Pip writes down the landmarks everyone saw, and when you crossed. The parts the spray hid stay blank. The workers add what they saw.

record_return.narration: You watched the whole change. Show the workers each part.

last_check.narration: Pip pretends to be the next traveler. "Hi, I am new!" he says, marching toward the water. He stops at the warning lantern. What should the warning tell travelers?

rest.narration: The river runs in its older bed again. Everyone is across, and the lantern waits for the next traveler. Pip closes his sketch with both river lines and the order of the change recorded. "An elder at the reading room has seen something like this in memory ice," says the worker. "Bring your account. She will want to compare it." You can follow the upper path to her or go back by the upper road.

variants.text: The tools stayed dry. Getting the far worker out came later.
The far worker climbed out. Her tools came later.
The kit is dry and ready for its next shift.
The workers must clean and dry the wet kit first.
Your account tells the whole change.
Your account leaves the missing part blank.

record_return_response_west.narration: The worker marks the falling western stream. The account has the whole change now.

record_return_response_old.narration: Pip marks the returning water beside the old channel. The account has the whole change now.

record_return_response_quiet.narration: The wet western line stays on the page for comparison. The account has the whole change now.

last_check_response_stop.narration: Pip stops at the lantern, well above the old bed. The workers will keep the warning lit.

last_check_response_look.narration: The worker checks both channels before offering a route. The workers will keep the warning lit.

last_check_response_ask.narration: The next traveler has someone to ask when the view changes. The workers will keep the warning lit.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.

npcVoices.Pip Thistledown: Manticore scout. Eager but learns to separate observation from guess; never knows an unseen event.
npcVoices.Yeti keepers: Slow, enormous and gentle. Deliberate before answering. Offer a safe method and leave unknown history unknown.
